logs.bandage: You tear a strip of cloth and bind the cut tight. The bleeding slows to a seep. Good enough to keep walking.
logs.rinse: You pour a little water over the cut first, wince, and wrap it in clean cloth.
logs.onset: The bandaged cut is hot and swollen under the cloth. A fever is coming on. The wound has turned.

journal.name: Cloth bandage
journal.text: Cloth closes a cut well enough to keep walking. Rinse it first, or the wound turns.

infectionJournal.name: Infected wound
infectionJournal.text: A dirty bandage can turn a cut into a fever: slow health loss, a hot body, slow hands. The first aid kit clears it. Rinse the wound before you wrap it.
